cues: PHP, created by Rasmus Lerdorf in nineteen ninety four, runs on a web server stack: an operating system, the Apache web server, the PHP interpreter and a MySQL database.
Save your file in the htdocs folder, start Apache and MySQL, and open it through localhost.

text: PHP, created by Rasmus Lerdorf in nineteen ninety four, runs on a web server stack: an operating system, the Apache web server, the PHP interpreter and a MySQL database. XAMPP bundles them. Save your file in the htdocs folder, start Apache and MySQL, and open it through localhost. Double clicking the file will not run the PHP at all.
